title: Mech Survivor is my first vibe coded game
author: philsodyssey
selftext: There are a lot of these "survivor" games but I've always wanted to make one. Still needs boss fights, more levels, more characters, more of everything.. But hey it has a leaderboard and it would be great to see some more competitive scores on it. Hope yall enjoy !

comments.author: Velvet-Thunder-RIP
comments.body: should work on loading and reloading, seems to be some bugs getting the game going.

replies.author: philsodyssey
replies.body: Hmmm. I have never ran into this bug. Curious what browser are you using ? Mobile or desktop ?

replies.author: philsodyssey
replies.body: Hmm it does take a few seconds to load but I've never had an issue on chrome.

replies.author: Velvet-Thunder-RIP
replies.body: Ok. Well as your product gets more visibility bugs that are less common can appear. I do not know what you gain by telling me this is never happened before.

comments.author: Lazy_Firefighter5353
comments.body: Nice game feels. Would you be able to share it to [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com) so other users can also give feedback?

comments.author: freeys
comments.body: Fun for 5 min. I ended up virtually invincible after a few mins due to stacking dmg reduction upgrades.

replies.author: philsodyssey
replies.body: Thanks for playing and the feedback. Wish you put up a score on the leaderboard with your build.

replies.author: freeys
replies.body:
I couldn’t die so idk how to exit the game to track the score.

I just exited the browser after level 15.

replies.author: philsodyssey
replies.body: Ha that's hilarious. Guess I need to cap the dmg reduction lol
